name: Robin Wall Kimmerer
shortBio: Citizen of the Potawatomi Nation, plant ecologist, and environmental philosopher; author of Braiding Sweetgrass, formulating the Grammar of Animacy and the Honorable Harvest through the synthesis of Indigenous wisdom and empirical botany.
centralQuestion: How can human culture reawaken to the world as a reciprocal community of sovereign, animate non-human beings through linguistic gratitude and the Honorable Harvest?

keyWorks.title: Braiding Sweetgrass: Indigenous Wisdom, Scientific Knowledge, and the Teachings of Plants
keyWorks.description: Luminous eco-philosophical treatise demonstrating how ecological science and indigenous traditional ecological knowledge (TEK) converge in kinship and reciprocity.

keyWorks.title: Gathering Moss: A Natural and Cultural History of Mosses
keyWorks.description: Biological and philosophical exploration of smallness, persistence, and non-exploitative ecological coexistence.
